# Cairn

> Cairn is a pre-launch market-research assistant. You ask it about a ticker, a sector or the market, and each answer comes back with the articles it read, the historical cases it compared and how confident it is. It is informational only: not a broker, no trade execution, and it never says buy, hold or sell.

Cairn has not launched yet. The only open action is joining the waitlist for early access.
